description: CPRM - SUSCEPTIBILIDADE À INUNDAÇÃO - ES is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Modelagem de inundação implementada nas Cartas de Suscetibilidade a Movimentos Gravitacionais de Massa e Inundações elaboradas pelo Serviço Geológico do Brasil - SBG, em atendimento às diretrizes específicas da Lei 12.608/2012 (BRASIL, 2012) que rege a Política Nacional de Proteção e Defesa Civil (PNPDEC). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are cprm_suscept_inundacao_es_epsg_31984, features, Brazil, BRA-Espirito Santo, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
